accounting_scope.note: The setup root and all wallet proofs were retained inputs. Only the height-eleven GPU trial contributes a new audited root.

remaining_limitations: Qualification covers one count-four candidate with one independently authorized issuance slot at height eleven.
Automatic selection is bounded by scan_limit (default 256, maximum 4096). Unselected bytes remain in intake.
Height-bound HTLC proofs must be renewed by the wallet for another height. The intake does not modify or re-prove them.
No pre-seal dispatch or active worker/coordinator recovery is qualified.
Isolated synthetic application does not establish sustained delivered transaction throughput.
Apple Silicon measurements are still pending.

timing_boundaries.note: Builder screening is inside the prepare-and-seal CLI interval. Both precede the GPU controller. Native application and intake replay are inside the owner/controller windows. Intervals overlap and must not be summed as disjoint stages.

timing_scope: One isolated revalidated height-eleven candidate. Baseline height ten used a retained root. All wallet proofs reused. Four fresh recursive proofs. No pre-seal dispatch, active recovery, matched speedup or sustained throughput qualification.
